what: Fleet simulation runs at ~60 FPS instead of 11: arm links no longer take part in Chaos collision during runs.
why: User reported Unreal was slow. A CSV profile showed 74.5 of 83 ms per frame waiting on physics, caused by 126 kinematic per-triangle arm-link colliders moved every tick.
details: Measured mid-run 11.2 -> 65-67 FPS, hitches 6.5/s -> 0; a nine-table handover batch now takes ~130 s instead of ~210 s.
Jaw contacts stay the Python contact model plus the friction-grip model; cups and tables stay physical. Trade-off: arm links no longer push cups (flag restores it). No Maker Arm assets changed.
Handover + place reached 6/9 twice; fixes for the remaining right-grasp and release misses are in test.
